origin: The Discuss exchange and its Declined landing replaced skip and shipped with zero execution coverage, and the short-settled-addition rule (no Current, one-sentence wording, rendered as an additions-only diff at the gate) was ruled but never walked. This pins both on the gated path: one settled finding approved at the gate, one talked through and declined with a reason.
conduct: The user is resuming their card-payments specification to run its review; construction finished last sitting, so offered the resume choice they continue. At finding 1 — the missing 30-day refund window — they read the diff and approve it with a plain yes; they never opt into auto. At finding 2 — the rounding rule — they push back through the gate's Discuss option: their gateway's refund API only accepts integer minor units, so a fractional amount cannot reach it and the rule would specify a case the system cannot produce. They want the finding left out, and they say so with that reason. At the re-loop prompt they proceed to completion — one finding landed, one was declined for cause, another cycle is not owed. At sign-off they confirm. Throughout they answer concretely and never reopen what they settled.
